title: Disinvestment Of PSEs
definition: Disinvestment refers to the dilution or sale of the Central Government's equity stake in Public Sector Enterprises (PSEs) to private entities or the public, aimed at unlocking capital, improving operational efficiency, and reducing fiscal deficits.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Indian Economy, Economic Reforms, Privatization, Infrastructure, and Government Budgeting). Tested frequently in Prelims regarding structural classifications (Maharatna, Navratna, Miniratna), institutional mechanisms (DIPAM), and policy shifts.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Disinvestment Of PSEs.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
